Name: LetsgoCamping
Author: lamya
Description:
This mod adds a Tent to the in game furniture catalogue that can be placed inside or outside and the player can sit inside of. It also replaces the games default Tent texture to a sleeping bag. The sleeping bag has a zipper added to make it easier to know where to click in place of what would be normally the Tent door. 

Credit to Minkeycookie without your mod to learn from I would not of been able to start, HimeTarts, and PlatinumCats without your furniture mods I would not of been able to learn the rest I needed to finish.
